cheats.name: Infinite handgun ammo
cheats.notes: G19 handgun: weapon 1, ammo type 31. Walks Jill's 20 inventory slots ([[re3.exe+0x8C6F648]+0xC0] -> +0x750 slot array) and picks the slot whose item has this weapon/ammo ID, so it survives rearranging and the game rebuilding the inventory.
